maqsoom.em: Split shared expenses for flats, hostels and trips
maqsoom.title: Maqsoom – Split Shared Expenses App for Android
maqsoom.desc: Maqsoom is an expense splitting app for Android. Note who paid for the flat, hostel mess, trip or office lunch and see who owes whom. Works offline, in English and Urdu.
maqsoom.keywords: maqsoom, split expenses app, shared expenses, hostel mess app, flat expenses, trip expense splitter, who owes whom
maqsoom.intro: Maqsoom keeps the shared hisaab of your flat, hostel room, trip or office lunch. Write who paid and what for. The app works out everyone's share and shows who should pay whom.
tiles: Add an expense in seconds
Type the amount or say it: "Ali paid 1500 for pizza". Voice works in Urdu, Roman Urdu and English, and the category is picked for you.
Split it your way
Equally, by exact amounts, shares or percent, item by item from a bill, or by meals. More than one person can pay the same expense.
Hostel mess
Count each person's meals every day. At the end of the month the food cost is split by meals.
Settle up
See who pays whom in the fewest payments, note how it was paid and send a polite reminder on WhatsApp.
Share with the group
Send a clean summary picture, a text summary, a PDF or a spreadsheet. Members can open the group file in their own Maqsoom.
Private and offline
No sign-up and no account. Your groups stay on your phone, with backup, PIN and fingerprint lock.
faq: What is Maqsoom?
Maqsoom is an app for splitting shared expenses. You write who paid; it shows each person's share and who should pay whom.
Who is it for?
People who share costs: flatmates, hostel students who run a mess, friends on a trip, office colleagues and families.
Does everyone need the app?
No. One person can keep the hisaab and send the summary picture to the group. Others can also open the group file in their own Maqsoom.
Where is my data kept?
On your phone. There is no account, and nothing is sent unless you share it yourself.

mazroof.title: Mazroof – Order Book App for Online Sellers on Android
mazroof.desc: Mazroof is an order book app for online sellers on Android. Paste the customer's message to fill the order, then track parcels, COD cash, stock and profit. Works offline, in English and Urdu.
mazroof.keywords: mazroof, order book app, online seller app, order management, cash on delivery tracker, parcel label, invoice maker
mazroof.intro: Mazroof is the order book for people who sell on WhatsApp, Instagram and Facebook. Paste the customer's message and the order is filled in for you. Then follow the parcel and the cash until the order is closed.
tiles: Paste the message
Name, phone, address, city and items fill in by themselves. It reads English and Urdu and knows more than 80 cities of Pakistan.
Follow each parcel
New, confirmed, packed, sent and delivered, with the courier and tracking number on every order.
Know your COD cash
See the amount to collect on each order and the total that is still with couriers.
Invoice and label
Send an invoice picture with your shop name and print a 4 x 6 parcel label as a picture or PDF.
Products and stock
Keep products with photo, price and cost. Stock counts itself and warns you when it runs low.
Reports and customers
Sales, profit, returns and expenses, best sellers, and every customer with their order history.
faq: What is Mazroof?
Mazroof is an order book for online sellers. It keeps orders, parcels, cash on delivery, products and customers in one app.
How does pasting a message work?
Copy the customer's message, tap "Paste customer's message" in a new order, and the details fill in. You can correct anything before saving.
Does it send messages by itself?
No. Messages open in WhatsApp with the text ready, and you press send.
Where is my data kept?
On your phone. There is no account, and you can save a backup file whenever you like.

mulsaq.em: Stickers from your photos and words
mulsaq.title: Mulsaq – Sticker Maker App for Android
mulsaq.desc: Mulsaq is a sticker maker for Android. Cut yourself out of any photo or type words in Urdu, Arabic or English, then add your sticker pack to WhatsApp.
mulsaq.keywords: mulsaq, sticker maker, urdu stickers, arabic stickers, whatsapp stickers, photo sticker maker, text stickers, truck art stickers
mulsaq.intro: Mulsaq turns your photos and words into stickers. Pick a photo and the background is removed on your phone, or type a few words and pick a style. Fill a pack and add it to WhatsApp in one tap.
mulsaq.featH2: Your photos and words, as stickers
tiles: Cut out any photo
Pick a photo and the background is removed right on your phone. Or cut it as a circle, rounded square or square, and fix the edges with the eraser.
Write in four ways
Type in Urdu, Roman Urdu, Arabic or English. Nastaliq, Gulzar, Lalezar and more, in cut-out, badge, bubble, 3D and truck art styles.
Ready packs
Salam & Dua, Everyday Urdu, Roman Urdu and Mubarak packs are ready to add. Truck Art and Desi Reactions open with one short ad.
Add to WhatsApp
Fill a pack with 3 to 30 stickers and tap Add to WhatsApp. Works with WhatsApp and WhatsApp Business.
Share anywhere
Send any sticker to other apps as a picture.
Private
No sign-up and no account. Your photos never leave your phone.
faq: What is Mulsaq?
Mulsaq (مُلصَق, Arabic for sticker) is a sticker maker app. It makes stickers from your photos and from words you type, and adds them to WhatsApp.
Which languages can I write in?
Urdu, Roman Urdu, Arabic and English. The app itself is in English and Urdu.
Are my photos uploaded anywhere?
No. The background is removed on your phone, and your stickers stay on your phone.
Is Mulsaq made by WhatsApp?
No. Mulsaq is made by Global Hosting Service and is not affiliated with WhatsApp or Meta. It uses WhatsApp's official sticker system.

thirty-tools.em: 30 handy tools for photos, videos and more
thirty-tools.title: Thirty Tools – Photo & Video Tools App for Android
thirty-tools.desc: Thirty Tools is an Android app with 30 handy tools: resize and compress photos, trim and compress videos, calculators, text tools and a unit converter. Your files stay on your phone.
thirty-tools.keywords: thirty tools, photo resizer, photo compressor, compress photo to 100 kb, video compressor, video trimmer, mute video, unit converter, percentage calculator, word counter
thirty-tools.intro: Thirty Tools puts the small jobs you do on your phone every week in one light app: make a photo fit a form, shrink a video before you send it, work out a discount, count the words in a message or convert units. Everything is done on your phone.
thirty-tools.featH2: Thirty small tools in one app
tiles: Photo tools
Resize to exact pixels, compress to an exact file size such as 100 KB or 200 KB, convert between JPG, PNG and WebP, crop, rotate and add a text watermark.
Video tools
Compress a video to 1080p, 720p, 480p or 360p, trim it, remove the sound or save one moment as a photo. A video can be up to 5 minutes long.
Calculators
Percentage, discount, tax, fuel cost for a trip, marks percentage, profit and margin, aspect ratio and split the bill.
Text tools
Word and character counter, change case, clean up text, remove duplicate lines, URL encoder and JSON formatter.
Everyday tools
Unit converter, date and age calculator, password generator, stopwatch with laps, quick notes and a color converter.
Private and offline
No sign-up and no account. Your photos, videos and text stay on your phone, and the tools work without an internet connection.
faq: What is Thirty Tools?
Thirty Tools is an Android app by Global Hosting Service with 30 small tools for photos, videos, calculations, text and everyday tasks, all in one app.
Can it make a photo smaller than 100 KB?
Yes. In the photo compressor choose To a file size, then pick 50 KB, 100 KB, 200 KB, 500 KB, 1 MB or 2 MB, or type your own size.
Are my photos and videos uploaded anywhere?
No. Photos, videos and text are processed on your phone. Nothing is uploaded and no account is needed.
Does it work without internet?
Yes. The tools work without an internet connection. Only the small banner advertisement at the bottom needs one.
Which phones does it work on?
Android phones with Android 9 or newer.
